title: Cheesy Roast Beef Sliders
creator: Nicole McLaughlin (Allrecipes)
ingredients: 1 package Hawaiian rolls, split in half horizontally
12 ounces thinly sliced deli roast beef
1/3 cup thin tangy BBQ sauce, such as Arby's Original Sauce
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Brush bottom and sides of a 9x13-inch baking dish with melted butter until lightly coated.
Arrange bottom halves of rolls in baking dish. Top evenly with roast beef slices; drizzle with BBQ sauce and dollop cheese sauce evenly over beef. Place top halves of rolls on top.
Stir remaining 3 tablespoons melted butter with garlic powder and onion powder; brush over roll tops. Sprinkle evenly with everything bagel seasoning.
Bake until the center is warm, cheese is melted, and rolls are toasted and golden brown on top, 12 to 14 minutes.
notes: From an Allrecipes Facebook Reel / Allrecipes page by Nicole McLaughlin: https://www.allrecipes.com/roast-beef-and-cheddar-sliders-recipe-8650250. Warm roast beef sliders on Hawaiian rolls with BBQ sauce and melty cheese.
